target_groups.notes: Phase 3 engine-wide expansion, tier 2: next-rung functions beyond the original 71, curated by probing the pinned engine for Excel-faithful semantics before fixture authoring.

Formula expansion batch 01: Trigonometry, hyperbolics and angle helpers. Expected values taken from Microsoft Excel (not from the engine); a function is included only when every one of its cases agrees between Excel and the pinned engine.

Formula expansion batch 02: Rounding variants, combinatorics, number bases and sums of products. Expected values taken from Microsoft Excel (not from the engine); a function is included only when every one of its cases agrees between Excel and the pinned engine.

Formula expansion batch 03: Information, logical and reference helpers. Expected values taken from Microsoft Excel (not from the engine); a function is included only when every one of its cases agrees between Excel and the pinned engine.

Formula expansion batch 04: Descriptive statistics, correlation and regression. Expected values taken from Microsoft Excel (not from the engine); a function is included only when every one of its cases agrees between Excel and the pinned engine.

Formula expansion batch 05: Probability distributions: normal, lognormal, exponential, discrete and gamma. Expected values taken from Microsoft Excel (not from the engine); a function is included only when every one of its cases agrees between Excel and the pinned engine.

Formula expansion batch 06: Probability distributions part 2, hypothesis tests and order statistics. Expected values taken from Microsoft Excel (not from the engine); a function is included only when every one of its cases agrees between Excel and the pinned engine.

Formula expansion batch 07: Regression and ranking statistics; date and time functions. Expected values taken from Microsoft Excel (not from the engine); a function is included only when every one of its cases agrees between Excel and the pinned engine.

Formula expansion batch 08: Engineering: base conversion, bit operations, error functions, COMPLEX and CONVERT. Expected values taken from Microsoft Excel (not from the engine); a function is included only when every one of its cases agrees between Excel and the pinned engine.

Formula expansion batch 09: Engineering: complex-number functions. Expected values taken from Microsoft Excel (not from the engine); a function is included only when every one of its cases agrees between Excel and the pinned engine.

Formula expansion batch 10: Bessel functions and core financial functions. Expected values taken from Microsoft Excel (not from the engine); a function is included only when every one of its cases agrees between Excel and the pinned engine.

Formula expansion batch 11: Dated financial functions, text conversion and AGGREGATE. Expected values taken from Microsoft Excel (not from the engine); a function is included only when every one of its cases agrees between Excel and the pinned engine.

Formula expansion batch 12: Database functions, CELL, INDIRECT and OFFSET. Expected values taken from Microsoft Excel (not from the engine); a function is included only when every one of its cases agrees between Excel and the pinned engine.

Formula expansion batch 13: Dynamic-array functions (values) and byte-oriented text functions. Expected values taken from Microsoft Excel (not from the engine); a function is included only when every one of its cases agrees between Excel and the pinned engine.

Formula expansion batch 14: LET and LAMBDA. Expected values taken from Microsoft Excel (not from the engine); a function is included only when every one of its cases agrees between Excel and the pinned engine.

Formula expansion batch 15: Regression cases: criteria-range sizes, whole-column references, CHISQ.TEST. Expected values taken from Microsoft Excel (not from the engine); a function is included only when every one of its cases agrees between Excel and the pinned engine.

Formula expansion batch 17: Criteria edge cases. Expected values taken from Microsoft Excel (not from the engine); a function is included only when every one of its cases agrees between Excel and the pinned engine.

Formula expansion batch 16: Criteria semantics matrix for the IF/IFS family. Expected values taken from Microsoft Excel (not from the engine); a function is included only when every one of its cases agrees between Excel and the pinned engine.

known_deviations.detail: Platform math-library difference in the last (15th) significant digit of the complex-number text result; macOS and iOS Simulator produce Excel's digit, Android's libm rounds this transcendental result differently. expected "-6.58066304055116-7.58155274274655i", got -6.58066304055116-7.58155274274654i

Platform math-library difference in the last (15th) significant digit of the complex-number text result; macOS and iOS Simulator produce Excel's digit, Android's libm rounds this transcendental result differently. expected "-0.065294027857947+0.0752249603027732i", got -0.0652940278579471+0.0752249603027732i
